item.description: Grok 4.6 is an excellent model. I’ve been using it heavily for the past couple of weeks and it handles everything from simple coding & code review all the way to designing and debugging complex systems with ease. What stands out even more is how strong it is outside of coding - deep research, long-form reasoning, planning, writing, and agentic workflows all feel noticeably sharper.
